purpose: Manual research ledger for lobby fixtures the automated sources could not resolve, plus irregularities noticed while verifying. Every entry is dated and linked. Nothing here sets a probability: entries only document name identities (aliases), source attempts and discrepancies. Rendered on board/unresolved.html.
research_order: HLTV match / event / team pages first
esportsbooks and esports betting feeds second
originate our own line from official ratings (Valve VRS) and published results (bo3.gg) last

entries.title: ex-CYBERSHOKE vs BlinkDagger — CIS LAN Championship #9, 2026-10-21 15:00 UTC
entries.status: resolved — market price via guarded ex- join
entries.finding: HLTV lists the WINLINE MPKBK CIS LAN Season 9 Group C opener as ex-CYBERSHOKE vs BlinkDagger (bo3, 21 Oct; ex-CYBERSHOKE roster bl1x1, Mokuj1n, nota, yiksrezo, shoke). HLTV's match and betting-analytics pages carry no moneyline (promo placeholders only). Bovada, Melbet and Kalshi price the same 15:00 UTC CIS LAN Championship match under the organisation name 'CYBERSHOKE' vs BlinkDagger. The board now joins an 'ex-' roster label to a bookmaker's organisation-name quote only when the opponent is identical and the kick-off is the same to the minute; the join is flagged on the row. The roster is NOT mapped to CYBERSHOKE's Valve VRS row (Valve's CYBERSHOKE line-up shares only 2 of 5 players).
entries.effect: Row 1082762 gets a market line (Bovada + Melbet + Kalshi, flag alias_ex_prefix_opponent_and_kickoff_triangulated).

entries.title: Zetta vs LOS NINOS — CCT South America 2026 Series #7, 2026-10-21 22:00 UTC
entries.status: resolved — originated Elo line (directional estimate); no bookmaker price found
entries.finding: HLTV lists the match as Zetta vs LOS NINOS (bo3, Swiss round 5, CCT 2026 South America Series 7); Zetta (HLTV team 13833, Peru) roster Notjuanjo, zockie, BabyRage, Antuanette, Slayerhz; LOS NINOS (HLTV team 14092, Brazil) unranked. bo3.gg lists the identical round-5 slot as 'Alianza Lima Esports vs Los Niños' with the identical five-man Zetta roster, so bo3.gg team 25489 'Alianza Lima Esports' is published as an alias of Zetta (evidence on the row). Valve's Americas standings list Zetta (#80, 473 pts; global #357); Los Niños has no Valve row. No reachable bookmaker prices the match: Pinnacle, Bovada, Melbet, Kalshi and Thunderpick (via bo3.gg) have no quote; HLTV's match page shows only a promo block; the Kambi/Unibet CS2 feed lists no CCT South America event. bo3.gg's own 'predicted win probability' is a site model, not a betting line, and is not used.
entries.effect: Row 1082837 gets an originated Elo line: Zetta seeded from its Valve points, Los Niños started at the lowest points value Valve publishes and moved by its 5 published results. Labelled directional; the row is flagged and listed here until a bookmaker prices it.

entries.title: Cross-check: independent session e1b48771 found the same price on a different book aggregator
entries.finding: Session e1b48771 (merged to main 2026-10-21 ~12:50 UTC) resolved the same row from kushvsporte.ru's odds board for 'CYBERSHOKE - BlinkDagger' (PARI 1.12 / WinLine 5.59 → no-vig 83.3% / 16.7%). This board's Bovada + Melbet + Kalshi consensus is 82.7% — the same price within 0.6 points, from different operators, which corroborates that the bookmakers' 'CYBERSHOKE' is HLTV's 'ex-CYBERSHOKE' for this match.
entries.effect: None on the number (kushvsporte.ru is not a collector source); recorded as agreement between two independent resolutions.

entries.title: paiN vs BARCA — Circuit X Curitiba #4, 2026-10-21 14:00 UTC (irregularity, no change)
entries.finding: HLTV's Circuit X Curitiba Season 4 schedule lists paiN vs BARCA at 10:00 local (14:00 UTC), matching HotSpawn, Pinnacle and Melbet. Bovada, Kalshi and bo3.gg list paiN vs 'Largados y Pelados' for the same slot. The strict opponent match kept those quotes out of the row (they appear under unmatched prices); only the two sources that name BARCA are used.
entries.effect: None — recorded so a reviewer can see why the row has 2 sources instead of 5.

entries.title: Cross-check: two directional methods for Zetta vs LOS NINOS disagree on size, not direction
entries.finding: Session e1b48771 published Zetta 55.2% as a documented LOWER BOUND (Valve curve, Zetta 473 pts vs the 381-pt floor, k = 0.4046). This board's Elo gives Zetta 75.8% because it also counts Los Niños's published 1-4 record since 13 Sep (losses to Quintessência twice, Procyon, Meia Noite; win over Grêmio), which pushes an unlisted team below the floor. Both are model output: same pick, different size. Neither is a bookmaker price; no bookmaker had priced the match at build time.
entries.effect: Row stays labelled directional and flagged; it switches to a market basis automatically if a quote joins before the 21:54 UTC lock.

entries.title: Donstu vs Banda chuya — CCT Europe 2026 Challengers #8, 2026-10-22 13:45 UTC (irregularity, no change)
entries.finding: HLTV lists DONSTU vs Banda Chuya (Upper Bracket Semi-final, 09:45 local = 13:45 UTC) exactly as HotSpawn does. bo3.gg's upcoming list shows 'DONSTU vs los kogutos' for that slot and no bookmaker in the collector priced the pairing at build time. The row keeps its Valve-VRS-originated line (both teams have a Valve row) until a bookmaker prices it.
entries.effect: None — bo3.gg naming discrepancy recorded; no quote was joined.

entries.title: Additional esportsbook feed checked: Kambi (Unibet) CS2 offering
entries.finding: The public Kambi offering API answers for CS2 (group 2010200623) with 41 events across nine tournaments (1W Private Club, BLAST Rivals Fall, CCT Challengers EU Series, Circuit X, DraculaN, IEM Beijing, PGL Masters Bucharest, STK Ranked, United21). It does not list CIS LAN Championship, CCT South America, NODWIN Clutch Series, Moscow Cyber Games or FRAG University, so it would not have priced the lobby's blank or model-only rows. Its sport-level path with the older 'counter_strike' term key returns 404. Logged for a future collector change; not used in this build.

entries.title: HLTV as a line source
entries.finding: HLTV match pages and 'Odds & prediction' pages for the low-tier fixtures checked (2399839, 2399865) show bookmaker promo placeholders without a numeric moneyline. HLTV's community 'pick a winner' percentage and bo3.gg's 'predicted win probability' are not betting lines and are never used as probabilities. From the GitHub Actions runner HLTV answers 403, so HLTV is read manually (this ledger) rather than by the collector.
entries.effect: HLTV is used for identity/kick-off verification only.

entries.title: Valve regional standings freshness
entries.status: verified — not stale on our side
entries.finding: The newest files in ValveSoftware/counter-strike_regional_standings live/2026 are the 2026_10_05 standings (checked via the GitHub contents API on 2026-10-21). The board's VRS snapshot 2026_10_05 is therefore the latest official publication, not a stale read.
